added_lines: liturgy of remembrance on wednesday november 4th at 7 pm we will remember and pray for all our deceased loved ones in a special candlelit liturgy of remembrance. this special liturgy is also open to all parishioners who would like to attend, and light a special votive candle in memory of their loved ones. st. vincent de paul collection the monthly collection for our svp conference will take place next weekend. monkstown
